description:
High-level Java SDK for ParticleDB. Idiomatic API over PDB-wire and
        gRPC transports — SQL, KV, Vector, RAG, and AI operations from a
        single fluent client. For drop-in JDBC use see ai.particledb:particledb-jdbc.
        Requires Java 11 or later; no JVM flags are needed on any JDK.
